# Data Dictionary

## Source Tables

| Table | Description |
|---|---|
| `customers` | Customer dimension including location and signup date. |
| `categories` | Product category dimension. |
| `products` | Product dimension with selling price and cost price. |
| `orders` | Order header table with customer, date, and status. |
| `order_items` | Order-line table with product, quantity, and unit price. |
| `exchange_rates` | EUR-based exchange-rate table used for multi-currency reporting. |

## Analytical Datasets Generated by Python

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `sales_fact_multicurrency.csv` | Order-line level fact table with customer, product, category, country, EUR revenue, currency conversion columns, and profit. |
| `daily_revenue_features.csv` | Daily aggregated feature table for sales forecasting. |
| `customer_features_rfm.csv` | Customer-level RFM and behavioral feature table for segmentation. |
| `sales_forecast.csv` | Historical model predictions and 30-day future revenue forecast. |
| `customer_segments.csv` | Customer records with assigned K-Means segment labels. |
| `customer_segment_summary.csv` | Segment-level customer count, revenue, recency, frequency, and average order value. |

## Key Metrics

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| Revenue | `quantity * unit_price`; source price is treated as EUR. |
| Average Order Value | Total revenue divided by distinct order count. |
| Recency | Days since a customer's most recent order. |
| Frequency | Number of distinct orders per customer. |
| Monetary Value | Total customer revenue in EUR. |
